Mental Health Care Plan Details

Principal Problem: Viral illness

- Clinical Goal(s): Manage symptoms, prevent complications
- Actions (Patient): Rest, hydrate, take Paracetamol, monitor symptoms
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Re-evaluate if symptoms persist/worsen

Secondary Problem: Diabetes and Hypertension Management
- Patient Goal(s): Maintain condition control
- Clinical Goal(s): Monitor and adjust management of diabetes and hypertension as necessary
- Actions (Patient): Continue adherence to medications
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Regular check-ups to assess condition control

- Education Given: Yes. Topics Covered: Symptom management, importance of rest and hydration, potential need for further medical evaluation
- Early Warning Signs of Relapse/Worsening: Persistent fever, worsening cough, breathing difficulties
- Coping Strategies: Adequate rest, return if symptoms do not improve
